# Motion Debugger

> Upgrade a vibe-coded website to premium with any coding agent and any model. A Markdown skill (premium-motion) runs an upgrade workflow, motion first, and a CLI critic records the local page in Chromium (entrance, scroll, hover, phone, reduced motion) and returns ranked fixes with screenshots. Nothing calls a model API. Works on macOS, Linux and Windows with Node.js 22+.

## Install (each line is one command)

- Full setup (critic, skill, agent config): `npm install -g https://github.com/ShadowKingYT444/motion-debugger/releases/latest/download/motion-debugger.tgz` then `motion-debugger init` in the project
- Skill for one agent: `npx skills add ShadowKingYT444/motion-debugger --skill premium-motion -a <agent>` (claude-code, cursor, codex, gemini-cli, github-copilot, windsurf, cline, roo, zed, opencode, goose, and ~70 more)
- Skill in the shared .agents/skills folder: `npx skills add ShadowKingYT444/motion-debugger --skill premium-motion -a universal -y`
- Skill without Node (bash, zsh): `mkdir -p .agents/skills && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ShadowKingYT444/motion-debugger.git /tmp/motion-debugger && cp -r /tmp/motion-debugger/plugin/motion-debugger/skills/premium-motion .agents/skills/`
- Skill without Node (PowerShell): `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ShadowKingYT444/motion-debugger.git $env:TEMP\motion-debugger; $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .agents\skills; Copy-Item -Recurse $env:TEMP\motion-debugger\plugin\motion-debugger\skills\premium-motion .agents\skills\`
- Critic with nothing installed: `npx -y -p https://github.com/ShadowKingYT444/motion-debugger/releases/latest/download/motion-debugger.tgz motion-debugger critique http://localhost:3000`
- Browser for the critic: `motion-debugger setup --browser` (an installed Chrome, Chromium or Edge also works, or set CHROMIUM_PATH)

## Use

- Tell the agent: "Use premium-motion upgrade on this site." Other commands: audit, direction, motion, signature, typeset, palette, imagery, compose, polish, harden.
- Critic: `motion-debugger critique <http://localhost:PORT | folder | index.html> [--desktop-only] [--json] [--out dir] [--fail-on blocker|major|minor|polish] [--github] [--open]`. Only loopback URLs and local files are allowed. Headless by default; `--fail-on` exits 2 when a finding is at or above that severity.
